verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              ततस्ते नरशार्दूला भ्रातरः पञ्च पाण्डवाः। प्रययुर्द्रौपदीं द्रष्टुं तं च देशं महोत्सवम्॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Then those best men, the five Pandava brothers, set out out to see Draupadi, the (Panchala) country and the festivities (of Svaimvara.)

verses.sanskrit: ते प्रयाता नरव्याघ्राः सह मात्रा परंतपाः। ब्राह्मणान्ददृशुर्मार्गे गच्छतः संगतान्बहून्॥२॥
verses.english: Those best of men, those chastisers of foes, saw with their mother many Brahmanas on their way going together (towards Panchala).

verses.sanskrit: त ऊचुर्ब्राह्मणा रजन्पाण्डवान्ब्रह्मचारिणः। भवन्तो गमिष्यन्ति कुतो वाऽभ्यागता इह॥३॥
verses.english: O king, those Brahmacharis, those Brahmanas, asked the Pandavas, “Where are you going? Whence have you come?

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच ।
              आगतानेकचक्रायाः सोदर्यानेकचारिणः । भवन्तो वै विजानन्तु सह मात्रा द्विजर्षभाः॥४॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said : O best of the twice born, know, Sirs, that we are five brothers travelling with our mother. We are now coming from Ekachakra.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः।
              गच्छताद्यैव पञ्चालान्द्रुपदस्य निवेशने । स्वयंवरो महांस्तत्र भाविता सुमहाधनः॥५॥
verses.english: The Brahmanas said: Go even this very day to the house of the Panchala Drupada. There will be held a great Svaimvara, in which a large sum of money will be spent. with eyes

verses.sanskrit: एकसार्थप्रयाताः स्म वयं तत्रैव गामिनः । तत्र ह्यद्भुतसंकाशी भाविता सुमहोत्सवः॥६॥
verses.english: We are going there; let us go together. Extraordinary festivities will take place there.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञसेनस्य दुहिता द्रुपदस्य महात्मनः। वेदीमध्यात्समुत्पन्ना पञ्चपत्रानिभेक्षणा ॥७॥
verses.english: The daughter of the illustrious Yajnasena Drupada was born from the sacrificial altar, like lotus leaves,

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनीयानवद्याङ्गी सुकुमारी मनस्विनी । धृष्टद्युम्नस्य भगिनी द्रोणशत्रोः प्रतापिनः॥८॥
verses.english: With features faultless and with beauty, youth and intelligence; she is the sister of the powerful Dhrishtadyuman, the (would be) slayer of Drona,

verses.sanskrit: यो जातः कवची खड्गी सशरः सशरासनः। सुसमिद्धे महाबाहुः पावके पावकोपमः॥९॥
verses.english: Who rose as a mighty-armed hero with natural armour, sword, bow and arrows from the blazing fire, himself looking like a second fire.

verses.sanskrit: स्वसा तस्यानवद्याङ्गी द्रौपदी तनुमध्यमा। नीलोत्पलसमो गन्धो यस्याः क्रोशात्प्रवाति वै॥१०॥
verses.english: His sister is the slender wasted and faultless featured Draupadi, whose body emits the Perfume of lotus over full two miles around.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञसेनस्य च सुतां स्वयंवरकृतक्षणाम् । गच्छामो वै वयं द्रष्टुं तं च दिव्यं महोत्सवम्॥११॥
verses.english: That daughter of Yajnasena will select a husband in a Svaimvara. We are going there to see her and witness the great celestials-like festivities.

verses.sanskrit: राजानो राजपुत्राश्च यज्वानो भूरिदाक्षिणाः। स्वाध्यायवन्तः शुचयो महात्मानो यतव्रताः ॥१२॥
verses.english: The kings and princes who are performers of sacrifices in which Dakshina is large, who are devoted to study, who are pure, who are high-souled and vow-observing,

verses.sanskrit: तरुणा दशेनीयाश्च नानादेशसमागताः । महारथा कृतास्त्राश्च समुपेष्यन्ति भूमिपाः॥१३॥
verses.english: Who are young and handsome, who are great car warriors and accomplished in arms, will all be present there from various countries.

verses.sanskrit: ते तत्र विविधान्दायान्विजयार्थं नरेश्वराः । प्रदास्यन्ति घनं गाश्च भक्ष्यं भोज्यं च सर्वेशः॥१४॥
verses.english: Being desirous of victory (to be successful in obtaining Draupadi)those kings, will all give away much wealth, kine, food and other articles of enjoyments.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिगृह्य च तत्सर्वं दृष्ट्वा चैव स्वयंवरम्‌ । अनुभूयोत्सवं चैव गमिष्यामो यथेप्सितम्॥१५॥
verses.english: Taking all that they will give, seeing the Svaimvara and enjoying the festivities, we shall then go wherever we like.

verses.sanskrit: नरा वैताछिकास्तत्र नर्तकाः सूतमागधाः। नियोघकाश्च देशेभ्यः समेष्यन्ति महाबलाः ॥१६॥
verses.english: There will come in that Svaimvara) from many countries, the singers of king's penegeries, the dancers, the reciters of Puranas, the heralds and the powerful athletes.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कौतूहलं कृत्वा दृष्ट्वा च प्रतिग्रह्य च । सहास्माभिर्महात्मानः पुनः प्रतिनिवर्त्स्यथ ॥१७॥
verses.english: O high-souled men seeing all these wonderful sights and taking what will be given away, you will also return with us.
verses.bhavadeepa: नटाः वेषभेदकारिणः । वैतालिकाः मङ्गलपाठकारिणः । नर्तकाः प्रसिद्धाः । सूताः पौराणिकाः मागधाः वंशसूचकाः नियोधकाः मल्लाः ॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनीयांश्च वः सवोन्देवरूपानवस्थितान्‌। समीक्ष्य कृष्णा वरयेत्संगत्यैकतमं वरम्‌ ॥१८॥
verses.english: You are handsome, you look all like the celestials: it may be that seeing you, Krishna may chose some one amongst you, superior to the rest, ( as her husband),

verses.sanskrit: अयं भ्राता तव श्रीमान्दर्शनीयो महासुजः। नियुज्यमानो विजये संगत्या द्रविणं बहु । आहरिष्यन्नयं नूनं प्रीतिं वो वर्धयिष्याति॥१९॥
verses.english: Your this brother is handsome and is endued with beauty; he is also mighty-armed; engaged in (athletic) encounters,) he may by chance earn great wealth.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच । परमं भो गमिष्यामो द्रष्टं चैव महोत्सवम्‌। भवाद्भिः सहिताः सर्वे कन्यायास्तं स्वयंवरम् ॥२०॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said: We shall all go with you to see that great festivity, that Svaimvara of (the Panchala) maiden.
